artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from significant generative artifacts, primarily in the interaction between accessories and anatomy. The `animal_pose_auditor` flagged a HIGH risk level due to >50% low-confidence keypoints, indicating the model struggled to resolve the skeletal structure beneath the harness and in the occluded hind legs.
